title: The Blacksmith and His Dog
summary: A blacksmith had a lazy dog that slept soundly through the ringing of the heavy hammer upon the anvil and the sparks flying from the forge....
full_text:
A blacksmith had a lazy dog that slept soundly through the ringing of the heavy hammer upon the anvil and the sparks flying from the forge.

Yet the moment the smith stopped hammering and began cutting bread and meat for dinner, the dog woke up instantly, wagging his tail and begging for food.

The smith rebuked the beast: "Lazy hound! The heavy blows of the hammer cannot wake you, but the quiet rattling of my teeth brings you to your feet in a second!"
moral: Those who sleep through the hour of labor have no right to feast at the hour of supper.
